gen-gf-shantell-sans-gf-encode-sans-semi: Wobbly and wide-mouthed, Shantell Sans draws every stroke with one fixed nib, while Encode Sans Semi Condensed keeps its arches low and its s open.
gen-gf-shantell-sans-gf-exo: Shantell Sans has no brush-style pressure swell anywhere, just a wide, tin-can mouth and a marker-like line. Exo follows in a plain sans, with gaps that keep text crisp.
gen-gf-shantell-sans-gf-figtree: Shantell Sans shows a mouth as wide as a tin can's cut lid, drawn with one fixed nib. Figtree adds marker-tip letters and open terminals, and that looseness is what ties them.
gen-gf-shantell-sans-gf-finlandica: Shantell Sans brings a wide-mouthed, fixed-nib hand to the top, with an expressive swagger. Finlandica below it stays a plain sans with open crossbars.
gen-gf-shantell-sans-gf-google-sans: Google Sans reads smooth and friendly, with no thick-thin shifts and terminals pulled well back. And its clean outlines keep a long stretch of text moving without a snag.
gen-gf-shantell-sans-gf-google-sans-flex: Loose and wide-mouthed, Shantell Sans scrawls its heading with one fixed nib, while Google Sans Flex ends each curve in a clean, open gap. Handmade meets tidy.
gen-gf-shantell-sans-gf-gotu: Hand-drawn and wide-mouthed, Shantell Sans lets its r, n and m arches match their stems. Gotu is a plain sans whose joins thin gently, so a long stretch stays sturdy.
gen-gf-shantell-sans-gf-gruppo: Shantell Sans keeps one steady pen pressure from its first letter to its last. It is the expressive, wide-mouthed voice, while Gruppo is the sans whose curve endings never crowd each other.
